# DV Design Studio

> Creatief bureau (Dromen Vormgeven) van Danique Vos, voor branding, webdesign, content, fotografie, video en AI-automatisering. Gevestigd in Nederland. Website gebouwd door DF Digital.

The live site is a single Dutch homepage with in-page sections. There is no published English translation yet.

## Site
- Home: https://www.dvdesign.studio/
- Studio: https://www.dvdesign.studio/#about
- Diensten: https://www.dvdesign.studio/#services
- Foto & video: https://www.dvdesign.studio/#fotovideo
- AI: https://www.dvdesign.studio/#ai
- Belofte: https://www.dvdesign.studio/#belofte
- Dienstenboekje: https://www.dvdesign.studio/#boekje
- Contact: https://www.dvdesign.studio/#contact

## Notes for crawlers
- Index the Dutch homepage. Alias HTML files (over.html, diensten.html, contact.html, portfolio.html) only redirect to homepage sections.
- Do not invent prices. Tariffs are shared via the dienstenboekje on request.
- A kennismakingsgesprek and the Dromen-scan are free.
